charts.description: Between 2022 and 2023, conversations about sustainable cities on Instagram increased by 2,143 percent, and discussions about electric potential rose by 407 percent. On Facebook, the topic of ecovillages saw increase of 1,132 percent, whilst agritourism conversations saw year-on-year growth of 627 percent on the platform.

charts.title: Year-on-year growth of internet and technology related conversations on Facebook and Instagram worldwide from 2022 to 2023
charts.short: Facebook and Instagram: global internet and technology conversation trends 2022-2023
charts.description: Between 2022 and 2023, conversations about haptic communication rose by 1,083 percent on Facebook. Overall, generative art discussions on Instagram saw an increase of 676 percent in the same period. Furthermore, conversations on Instagram about artificial intelligence rose by 173 percent year-on-year, whilst #metaverse saw increases of 122 percent on the social media platform. Topics surrounding life simulation games and computer art also saw year-on-year growth on social media.
charts.note: 2022 to 2023; analyzed using over four million global conversations on Facebook and Instagram

charts.title: Year-on-year growth of culture related conversations on Facebook and Instagram worldwide from 2022 to 2023
charts.short: Facebook and Instagram: cultural conversation trends 2022-2023
charts.description: Between 2022 and 2023, C-pop, or Chinese pop, conversations grew by almost 1600 percent on Instagram. charts.note: Worldwide; 2022 to 2023; analyzed using over four million global conversations on Facebook and Instagram

charts.title: Year-on-year growth of beauty and body positive related conversations on Facebook and Instagram worldwide from 2022 to 2023
charts.short: Facebook and Instagram: beauty and body positive conversation trends 2022-2023
charts.description: Between 2022 and 2023, Facebook and Instagram saw an increase in conversations around body positivity, autonomy, and self-expression. Overall, conversations about epilators saw a year-on-year increase of 512 percent, and body modification discussions saw a year-on-year increase of 258 percent. On Instagram, conversations over chemical depilatory rose by 123 percent. Additionally, discussions about body positivity increased by 47 percent, year-on-year.
charts.note: Worldwide; 2022 to 2023; analyzed using over four million global conversations on Facebook and Instagram
